body: Owner instructed: do not ask, finish all. Kept as built, each matching better-auth or documented: (1) WithoutOriginCheck stays, documented as one-click takeover risk, CR/LF and backslash always refused; (2) ReuseCodeOnResend HMAC-derived or sealed codes; (3) phone.SignInRequest breaking change, needs its CHANGELOG line; (4) sign-up fields limited to WithUserColumns; (5) KV cutoff max(7d, longest token) with the cross-process gap documented; (6) WithVerificationStore separate opt-in; (7) WeChat secret in token URL per WeChat docs. (8) hosted demo, in-docs AI chat, docs MCP server, npx installer, videos: out of scope for a library, not built. (9) missing CHANGELOG lines: written in this pass.
title: Review of delegated decisions r6/r20/r21 (owner said keep working, 2026-10-10)
